title: Looper events --json line (legacy contract, frozen)
description: One line of the newline-delimited JSON stream that `looper events --json` and `looper tail --json` emit today. NDJSON stays the format for explicit streaming; finite event queries return one document per call under contract version 2 (AX-006). The optional structured identity fields arrive with AX-007.

data.description: Structured payload the event was written with. Absent when the writer supplied none.
